_snapshot: PROPOSED — not yet created in n8n. Sends S2, the booked-call confirmation SMS, and closes out any pending recovery follow-up for the same person. Built as a SUB-WORKFLOW (Execute Workflow trigger) rather than its own iClosed webhook, because iClosed points one URL at the 'Call booked' event and that URL already belongs to 'Sales — Call Booked (iClosed)'. Wiring it up therefore needs a ONE-NODE change to that live router — an Execute Workflow node on the normal-funnel branch — which per CLAUDE.md requires Sidney's explicit go-ahead before anyone touches it. Expected input: { first_name, phone, email, call_start_iso, timezone }. BEFORE IMPORT: replace the Data Table id, the Twilio number, and the Error Workflow id.
